high_level_description: This image captures a serene coastal scene during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, given the warm hues in the sky. The sky is filled with soft, pastel-colored clouds that transition from pinkish-orange near the horizon to a darker gray as they extend upwards. These clouds are scattered across the sky, adding depth and texture to the scene. The ocean below is calm with gentle waves lapping at the shore. The water has a muted brownish-gray tone, reflecting the subdued lighting of the time of day.
